elder.name: Elder Rowan
elder.greeting: Welcome, trainer. The bosses grow restless. Make your monsters strong before they come.

ranger.name: Ranger Ivy
ranger.greeting: The wilds past the meadow are dangerous alone. Bring friends to the marsh.

sage.name: Sage Orla
sage.greeting: The crystals sing of a monster unlike any other. Prove yourself and they may sing for you.

quests.name: First Steps
quests.description: Defeat 3 wild monsters in the Sunny Meadow.

quests.name: Friends in the Grass
quests.description: Catch 2 wild monsters. The elder will teach you to spot rare ones.

quests.name: Forest Patrol
quests.description: Defeat 5 wild monsters in the Mossy Forest.

quests.name: Type Collector
quests.description: Catch one monster of each type: Spark, Stone and Tide.

quests.name: Into the Marsh
quests.description: Defeat 4 wild monsters in Murkwater Marsh. Bring a friend!

quests.name: Crystal Resonance
quests.description: Defeat 6 monsters in the Crystal Cave. The crystals will then call a unique monster, for you alone.
